panels.title: Стоимость успешного голосового обмена
panels.description: Фактические известные расходы STT + LLM + TTS только по голосовым с распознанной речью и доставленным голосовым ответом, делённые на число таких обменов за выбранный период. При неполных ценах это нижняя граница. История начинается после включения нового учёта.

targets.rawSql:
WITH per_exchange AS (
  SELECT e.attempt_id, e.expected_stt, e.expected_llm, e.expected_tts,
         date_trunc('day', e.delivered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow' AS day,
         coalesce(sum(c.cost_micro_usd), 0) AS known_micro,
         count(c.call_id) AS calls,
         count(c.call_id) FILTER (WHERE c.price_status = 'known') AS priced,
         count(c.call_id) FILTER (WHERE c.component = 'stt') AS stt,
         count(c.call_id) FILTER (WHERE c.component = 'llm') AS llm,
         count(c.call_id) FILTER (WHERE c.component = 'tts') AS tts
  FROM voice_cost_exchanges e
  LEFT JOIN voice_cost_calls c ON c.attempt_id = e.attempt_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(e.delivered_at)
  GROUP BY e.attempt_id, day
)
SELECT sum(known_micro)::double precision / 1000000 / nullif(count(*), 0) AS value FROM per_exchange

panels.title: Обменов с полной ценой
panels.description: Доля успешных обменов, для которых записаны STT, LLM и TTS и известна цена каждого фактического вызова. 100% возможно только без неизвестных цен и пропавших компонентов.

targets.rawSql:
WITH per_exchange AS (
  SELECT e.attempt_id, e.expected_stt, e.expected_llm, e.expected_tts,
         date_trunc('day', e.delivered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow' AS day,
         coalesce(sum(c.cost_micro_usd), 0) AS known_micro,
         count(c.call_id) AS calls,
         count(c.call_id) FILTER (WHERE c.price_status = 'known') AS priced,
         count(c.call_id) FILTER (WHERE c.component = 'stt') AS stt,
         count(c.call_id) FILTER (WHERE c.component = 'llm') AS llm,
         count(c.call_id) FILTER (WHERE c.component = 'tts') AS tts
  FROM voice_cost_exchanges e
  LEFT JOIN voice_cost_calls c ON c.attempt_id = e.attempt_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(e.delivered_at)
  GROUP BY e.attempt_id, day
)
SELECT sum(CASE WHEN expected_stt > 0 AND expected_llm > 0 AND expected_tts > 0 AND stt = expected_stt AND llm = expected_llm AND tts = expected_tts AND calls = priced THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::double precision / nullif(count(*), 0) AS value FROM per_exchange

panels.title: Неизвестные цены и расхождения
panels.description: Число вызовов без цены плюс несовпадения между ожидаемым числом вызовов и сохранёнными записями STT, LLM и TTS. Если AI не передал счётчики, обмен тоже считается неполным.

targets.rawSql:
WITH per_exchange AS (
  SELECT e.attempt_id, e.expected_stt, e.expected_llm, e.expected_tts,
         date_trunc('day', e.delivered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow' AS day,
         coalesce(sum(c.cost_micro_usd), 0) AS known_micro,
         count(c.call_id) AS calls,
         count(c.call_id) FILTER (WHERE c.price_status = 'known') AS priced,
         count(c.call_id) FILTER (WHERE c.component = 'stt') AS stt,
         count(c.call_id) FILTER (WHERE c.component = 'llm') AS llm,
         count(c.call_id) FILTER (WHERE c.component = 'tts') AS tts
  FROM voice_cost_exchanges e
  LEFT JOIN voice_cost_calls c ON c.attempt_id = e.attempt_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(e.delivered_at)
  GROUP BY e.attempt_id, day
)
SELECT sum(calls - priced + CASE WHEN expected_stt IS NULL OR expected_llm IS NULL OR expected_tts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE abs(expected_stt - stt) + abs(expected_llm - llm) + abs(expected_tts - tts) END) AS value FROM per_exchange

panels.title: Начало полного учёта
panels.description: Московская дата первого доставленного голосового обмена, для которого AI передал ожидаемое число STT, LLM и TTS вызовов. С более ранних дат цена может быть неполной.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(min(delivered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow'), 'DD.MM.YYYY') AS value FROM voice_cost_exchanges WHERE expected_stt IS NOT NULL AND expected_llm IS NOT NULL AND expected_tts IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Стоимость успешного обмена по дням
panels.description: Московские календарные дни доставки. Каждая точка пересчитывается, когда провайдер позже возвращает цену TTS. При неполном покрытии показана нижняя граница; см. долю обменов с полной ценой.

targets.rawSql:
WITH per_exchange AS (
  SELECT e.attempt_id, e.expected_stt, e.expected_llm, e.expected_tts,
         date_trunc('day', e.delivered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow' AS day,
         coalesce(sum(c.cost_micro_usd), 0) AS known_micro,
         count(c.call_id) AS calls,
         count(c.call_id) FILTER (WHERE c.price_status = 'known') AS priced,
         count(c.call_id) FILTER (WHERE c.component = 'stt') AS stt,
         count(c.call_id) FILTER (WHERE c.component = 'llm') AS llm,
         count(c.call_id) FILTER (WHERE c.component = 'tts') AS tts
  FROM voice_cost_exchanges e
  LEFT JOIN voice_cost_calls c ON c.attempt_id = e.attempt_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(e.delivered_at)
  GROUP BY e.attempt_id, day
)
SELECT day AS "time", sum(known_micro)::double precision / 1000000 / count(*) AS value FROM per_exchange GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Речь пользователя на разговор · по дате начала
panels.description: Закрытые практические звонки с полными фактами. Старые звонки считают длительность записи с паузами; новые дни считают речевые интервалы VAD. Возврат к старому расчёту показан отдельно. Московские даты начала; история до начала сбора не восстановлена.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(speech_seconds) / NULLIF(SUM(calls), 0) / 60 AS "Минут речи / разговор",
SUM(calls) AS "Звонков", SUM(legacy_calls) AS "Старый метод", SUM(vad_calls) AS "Новый метод",
SUM(mixed_calls) AS "Смешанных", SUM(fallback_turns) AS "Fallback ходов",
SUM(excluded) AS "Исключено", SUM(incomplete) AS "Неполных",
(SELECT MIN(day) FROM habit_call_daily) AS "История с"
FROM habit_call_daily
WHERE day BETWEEN (to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::date
AND (to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo()) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::date
